title: Finite biproduct decomposition of the tensor source
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], open U, cochain complexes P,F of module sheaves on U, and integers a,b,n, suppose P^r is zero for r<a or b<r. Put D=Hom(P,O_U[0]) [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data]. There is an isomorphism from the biproduct indexed by integers a<=r<=b of F^(r+n) tensor D^(-r) to degree n of Tot(F tensor D). Its composite with each biproduct inclusion is the total tensor inclusion for p=r+n and q=-r. No bound on F is assumed.

proof_origin.description: Formalized the source finite-support argument using the product fan and explicit inverse to the tensor coproduct map; no new unproved statements.

proof.text: Use homComplex_projections_exists to obtain the product-limit fan in degree q. If -q lies outside [a,b], every internal Hom factor vanishes: when r+q=0 use boundedness of P at r=-q; otherwise use the zero degree r+q of the single unit complex. Internal Hom with a zero source or target is zero by the tensor-Hom equivalence and preservation of zero objects by tensorRight. The limit fan hom_ext then proves the dual degree is zero, without constructing a dual-degree identification.

Construct the forward map by biproduct.desc of the specified total tensor inclusions. Construct its inverse by HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorDesc: on a summand (p,q) with p+q=n, use the biproduct inclusion indexed by r=-q after transporting p=-q+n and q=-(-q) when r belongs to Icc a b, and zero otherwise. Prove the first inverse identity by biproduct.hom_ext' and the second by mapBifunctor.hom_ext. Inside the interval, transport of equal indices gives the identity on each summand; outside, tensorLeft preserves the zero dual degree from step 1. The forward map satisfies each inclusion equation by biproduct.ι_desc. The same construction works for b<a because all tensor summands are zero.

lean.statement: theorem ordinaryEvaluation_source_biproduct (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (P F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ) (a b n : ℤ) (hbounded : ∀ r : ℤ, r < a ∨ b < r → IsZero (P.X r)) : ∃ e : (⨁ fun r : ↥(Finset.Icc a b) ↦ F.X (r.val + n) ⊗ (localEvaluationDual X U P).X (-r.val)) ≅ (localEvaluationTensor X U P F).X n, ∀ r : ↥(Finset.Icc a b), biproduct.ι _ r ≫ e.hom = HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor F (localEvaluationDual X U P) (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) (r.val + n) (-r.val) n (by change r.val + n + -r.val = n; omega)
